podcast.body: This song is the title track from their 1983 self-titled debut album. It features lyrics that depict a scenario of a young person feeling unheard and misunderstood by their family, culminating in a mother screaming the child's name after being ignored. The song is highlighted as a great example of California hardcore, and simultaneously shows the beginnings of trash metal and skate punk.
